isi-ben-yehuda.name: Isi ben Yehuda
isi-ben-yehuda.bio: Tanna cited in baraitot; Pesaḥim 113b says that he was also known by other names, among them Yosef HaBavli.
isi-ben-yehuda.prompt: A sage in his 50s with a dark beard touched with grey and a deep blue wool mantle, holding out an empty bowl as he makes a comparison; background of a study house with limestone walls and an oil lamp.

rabbi-mani-bar-pattish.name: Rabbi Mani bar Pattish
rabbi-mani-bar-pattish.bio: Amora who gives the Rabbis’ source in Leviticus 12:2 for their ruling on a caesarean birth in Keritot 7b.
rabbi-mani-bar-pattish.prompt: A sage in his 40s with a short dark beard and a terracotta-coloured linen mantle, pointing to a line in an open scroll as he cites a verse; background of a study hall lit by an oil lamp.
